extracted.intended_audience: literate 19th-century newspaper readers interested in current events, literature, and memorials (readers of the New-York Tribune)
extracted.subtask_description: A newspaper-piece assembling letters, eyewitness reports, obituary notices, and memorial poems about Margaret Fuller and the wreck of the brig Elizabeth, presented for a general literate public. It is a historical news/memorial compilation rather than a guideline or evaluative rubric.
